rules.title: Security deposits and upfront charges (c.186 s.15B)
rules.requirement: At or before move-in a landlord may charge only first month's rent, last month's rent, a security deposit of one month's rent and the cost of a key and lock. Deposit must be held in a separate interest-bearing account, with a statement of condition, receipts, interest and return within 30 days; violations can cost triple damages.
rules.key_value: 1 month's rent deposit cap (plus first and last month and key/lock cost)
rules.exemptions: Leases or tenancies of 100 days or less for vacation or recreational purposes
rules.quoted_span: (iii) a security deposit equal to the first month's rent provided that such security deposit is deposited as required by subsection (3)
rules.interaction: Statewide; no local deposit rule in these documents.

exempt_if.unavailable: lease, rental, occupancy or tenancy of 100 days or less for vacation or recreational purpose

notes: No owner-occupied two-family exception appears in the s.15B text, so none is modeled (brief claim not supported by text). Effective date 2025-08-01 is the 2025 c.9 amendment of clause (b) (adds agents of the lessor and the fee in lieu of deposit); the one-month cap itself predates it. Upfront-charge limits are merged here, not a separate application_screening_fees record.
